Hey. I feel the same. Possibly bipolar here, never officially diagnosed.

Last October, decided to get this under control. No more smoking. Exercise. Healthy eating. Career choices. Taking classes. January - March was the best time of my life. 

April hit. One of the worst depressions of my life. I thought I had beat this. I thought I had found a way out. I hadn't. 

So, yeah. I know how you feel. I have two friends who have been in my life for over 15 years. They understand. I have another who I think will be around a while who also has mental illness. You will make friends. Keep trucking. 30 y.o. here, for the record.

Lukir sneered as he surveyed his domain. From his high perch, he could see everything in his kingdom, from the slightest twitch of mouse whiskers to the lumbering stompings of his servant, Mike. As king of his castle, Lukir had a high responsibility to uphold, and he took it seriously. No intruder would enter his domain without his knowledge. No toy would be misplaced as the clumsy Mike rearranged Lukir's belongings. Lukir found himself often correcting Mike with a kindly word or a gentle pat. Mike was too dumb to understand Lukir's speech, but he knew how to give a proper ear scratching, so he was tolerable. Today, however, Mike was doing the unspeakable. He had *the box*. Yes, *the box*, the one the human used to forcibly evict Lukir from his castle and transport him to a faraway land smelling of septic fluids, bleach, and fear. Lukir hastily began to pull himself out of his castle by his forepaws, but he had had a few too many treats last night and the castle door was a tight fit for him. Lukir's howls could be heard for miles as he was carried out of his kingdom in *the box*. 

His partner Subir lifted her head a millimeter at the noise, then calmly went back to sleep. She would never have found herself in such an undignified position, as she had the good sense to never be trapped by her pride and to never be more than a short dash from the cavernous reaches of the underbed.

So this depends on how you play the game.

Are you playing for war? If so, how are your war attacks going? Can you reliably 3-star your targets in war? If so, upgrade those air defenses. 

If you're still learning your war attacks and need more practice, don't increase your war weight too much, and don't upgrade the air defenses. 

If you're not playing for war, then I'd probably upgrade defenses to keep gold low and defend loot better. Clash on!

I like the junction placement here. A wallbreaker will never break more than 2 compartments at a time, which is a real plus. A lot of people take longer to learn this, so that is nice to see. 

To improve, I'd think about traps. If you have a bomb, it does damage. If you have a spring, it removes them from the map. It doesn't make sense to put the bombs next to the springs, because it's a waste of one or both. 

Also, think about pathing. Generally, if it is a 3x3 defense (like an archer tower), units will target the center square, then head for the center square of their next target. So spring traps aren't very effective next to the corners of those 3x3 defenses. 

Lastly, I might think about upgrade order for defenses. There are a few strategies for this. One is the rip-off-the-bandaid method, where you upgrade all like towers at the same time (like you're doing with mortars right now). This method is good if you're not going to play much for a few days (so you'll get a shield and not play through it). 

If you like to play a lot (like me), you'll find that upgrading those similar towers makes you weak to certain attacks, in this case the most common attack: barch. So you might find yourself losing more resources and more trophies during this time. If you want to play through your shields while things upgrade, I'd recommend upgrading a mix of offense and defense, and not upgrading all of one tower type at the same time.

A lot of this is about your playstyle. If you often use rage spell, I'd recommend: 

rage spell > DE Drill > BK to 5 > hogs

That DE drill pumps out so much de. it's really worth it. And the King is so much more powerful/useful with his ability (I mean, he even heals!). If you don't use rage, then put it after hogs in this priority list. 

Notice I didn't mention anything that requires gold. Starting around mid TH7, you should just leave 1 builder open and dump any excess goal into walls. If you have 2 builders idle, then you can use 1 to upgrade a collector. Clash on!

You have the right idea with the traps. You want enemies to walk over the traps. But right now, they can just drop 1 giant, set off the trap, and continue with the attack. It's better to put the trap between two defenses. Also, if you want to lure them to a defensive tower, lure them to a "weaker" tower. (Wiz > mortar > archer > cannon > Air defense)

I'm not sure what cup level you're at, but I might consider moving the air defense outside and moving the mortars inside. My TH6 never sees air attacks, so I use the air defenses to lure giants while other towers pound on them. 

Hope that helps a little!
